question: What was Salesforce's current RPO at the end of Q2 FY2027, its YoY growth in both nominal and constant currency, and what share of total RPO it represents?
grading: cRPO ±0.5%, USD billions; growth rates exact as disclosed (both labeled correctly); share ±1pp
answer: Salesforce cRPO at July 31, 2026 was USD 33.5 billion, up 14% YoY in both nominal and constant currency terms. Total RPO was USD 66.3 billion, so cRPO represented 50.5279% of total RPO. [G07-E1]

output.answer:
Based on Salesforce's Q2 FY2027 earnings report (for the quarter ended July 31, 2026), here are the RPO metrics:

| Metric | Q2 FY2027 Value | YoY Growth | Source |
|--------|-----------------|------------|--------|
| **Current RPO (cRPO)** | **$33.5 billion** | **+14%** (nominal and constant currency) | [EarningsLens.ai](https://www.earningslens.ai/report/crm/2026-Q3), [Note.com analysis](https://note.com/gemiko/n/n8e03005687d0) |
| **Total RPO** | **~$66.3 billion** | **+11%** | [EarningsLens.ai](https://www.earningslens.ai/report/crm/2026-Q3) |

### Key Details:
- **Current RPO share of Total RPO**: approximately **50.5%** ($33.5B ÷ $66.3B)
- **Constant currency growth**: Also reported at **+14%** for cRPO
- **Context**: cRPO growth accelerated from earlier quarters, with management noting "the strongest net new annual order value in four years" and near-record low attrition

This compares to Q1 FY2027 (ended April 30, 2026), when cRPO was $33.6 billion (up 14% YoY, 13% constant currency) and Q4 FY2026 total RPO stood at $72.4 billion.
